svg.aria-label: All three start from C4 + E4, a major third of 4 semitones. Change 1, upper voice up one semitone: C4 + F4, a perfect fourth of 5 semitones. Change 2, lower voice down one semitone: B3 + E4, a perfect fourth of 5 semitones. Change 3, lower voice up two semitones: D4 + E4, a major second of 2 semitones.
svg.title: Three changes from one beginning

g.text: How to read this graphic: Each card names the
change in words, then lists the start pair
and the end pair with their colour bars.
Compare the end swatches: the first two
changes land on the same colour, because both
give 5 semitones, even though different notes
